verdict.rationale: Zero ships a built-in AI assistant that can compose emails, answer questions about mailbox/thread content, perform web search, and manage labels/search per its own MCP.md docs, and this is independently corroborated by a founder/community description of it as an AI email client that summarizes, drafts, and lets users 'chat with their inbox.' Missing for 10: deeper hands-on verification of assistant quality/reliability beyond one community comment and confirmation the OAuth-based access path (still 'coming soon') doesn't limit availability.
